subject: API pricing: monthly tokens + peak TPS — BrightHealth follow-up
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@brighthealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: API pricing: monthly tokens + peak TPS — BrightHealth follow-up

Hi Sara,

Great to meet today — thanks for walking us through BrightHealth's user flows. Quick recap from our side and a few asks to firm up pricing guidance:  

- Current target scope we discussed: clinical triage chat + appointment summarization + post-visit notes generation.
- Key inputs we need to finalize a hosted API estimate:
  1) Expected total monthly tokens (input + output) for a 6–12 month rollout window.
  2) Expected peak TPS (concurrent requests at busiest hour) — helps size reserved capacity vs. burst.
  3) Any hard budget band for API spend (monthly), or a target unit cost you want us to hit (e.g., $X per 1M tokens).

You mentioned an internal usage projection spreadsheet — if you can attach that, we can run it through our optimizer and propose a tiered recommendation (hosted spot vs reserved burst) and an expected $/1M tokens figure.

Attached: our standard next-steps checklist (embedded in the demo deck). I'll also pull together a preliminary pricing sketch once I have the numbers above. If it'd help, we can run a short load profile test on a sample prompt set to validate peak TPS assumptions.

Next steps I propose:
- You share the monthly token projection and peak TPS estimate (or the spreadsheet) by EOD Thu Nov 5.
- I will return a 2-tier proposal (conservative & aggressive) with unit economics and recommended routing policy by Fri Nov 6.

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

P.S. If procurement prefers a single contact, please copy procurement@brighthealth.com on the reply and I'll include billing/accounting details.

From: Sara Patel <sara@brighthealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: API pricing: monthly tokens + peak TPS — BrightHealth follow-up

Ben — thanks for the recap and the clear asks. Attaching the usage worksheet we referenced (high-level, confidential). High-level numbers are below:  

- Monthly tokens (combined input+output):
  - Month 1 (pilot): ~12M tokens
  - Month 6 (post-rollout projection): ~180M tokens
  - Steady-state target (12+ months): ~420M tokens / month
- Peak TPS:
  - Pilot peak: ~6 TPS
  - Post-rollout peak (expecting same-day spikes): ~45 TPS sustained for short bursts (10–15 mins)
- Budget guidance:
  - Initial pilot budget: ~$2k–5k/month
  - Target steady-state budget: aiming for >=$2.5k/month cap initially but we have flexibility if unit economics justify it.
- Target unit economics (internal): attempting to keep costs < $400 per 1M tokens for the first 6 months; long-term target is <$200 per 1M tokens.

Attaching: BrightHealth_expected_usage.xlsx (has line-item breakdown by workflow). Please keep the sheet internal to the pricing thread.

We are also checking with procurement for any required vendor forms and will loop them in once we have a ballpark.

Thanks,
Sara

--
Sara Patel
Product Lead, Clinical AI | BrightHealth
sara@brighthealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fw: API pricing: monthly tokens + peak TPS — BrightHealth follow-up

Vanessa / Markus — forwarding BrightHealth's reply (attached usage workbook). Key asks: 420M tokens/month steady-state target, peaks ~45 TPS, initial pilot budget constrained ($2k–5k). They have internal target unit economics: < $400 / 1M tokens short-term, < $200 long-term.

Questions for pricing guidance:
- Can we meet a pilot proposal that keeps their cost under ~$400/1M while covering our hosted margins at pilot volumes?
- For peak handling: recommend routed autoscaling with short-burst reserved capacity + fallback to a slightly smaller quantized variant for extreme spikes. Does product think 45 TPS requires a dedicated burst pool or can we rely on our hosted burst?

I can share a conservative vs aggressive sketch with them once I have approval on the discount band and the recommended routing policy.

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 10:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fw: API pricing: monthly tokens + peak TPS — BrightHealth follow-up

Thanks for the context. Quick notes:  

- Pricing band: for pilot (12M -> 180M range) we can offer an introductory hosted tier with a blended rate of $350 / 1M tokens for the first 3 months (with a 20% credit applied to overage for pilot customers who commit to a post-pilot contract). That meets their short-term target.
- For steady-state (>=420M): recommend reserved commit pricing; we can target $180–$220 / 1M tokens depending on commit level and length (12 vs 24 months).
- Peak handling: 45 TPS short bursts — ops confirms that hosted burst capacity can absorb the spikes if we enable our burst routing with auto-fallback to quantized variant after 30s. If BrightHealth needs sustained 45 TPS over many minutes, we'd advise a modest reserved burst (one GPU pool) — quantify in proposal.

Ben: please send draft proposal that includes:
  - Pilot blended rate ($350/1M for first 3m) and sample monthly invoice for 12M and 180M scenarios
  - Steady-state reserved commit options: 12m & 24m with $/1M tiers and estimated monthly invoices for 420M tokens
  - Operational note on how we handle 45 TPS spikes and suggested runbook for them

I will attach Redwood_pricing_v2.pdf (standard public sheet) and cc billing if we need to lock a quoted rate.

- Vanessa

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: API pricing: monthly tokens + peak TPS — BrightHealth follow-up

Sara — thanks for the detailed numbers and for sharing the workbook. Attached is Redwood_pricing_v2.pdf with the public tiers plus a short conservative/aggressive sketch based on your numbers:  

Pilot proposal (months 0–3):
- Blended pilot rate: $350 / 1M tokens (applies to usage up to 200M/month)
- Example invoices: 12M tokens -> $4.20 (pilot credit applied, minimal example); 180M tokens -> $63.00 (illustrative; final will include rounding/fees)

Steady-state recommendation (>=420M):
- Recommended reserved commit: 12-month commit at $200 / 1M tokens; 24-month at $180 / 1M tokens (discounts tied to minimum commit).
- If BrightHealth signs 12m @ 420M baseline, monthly invoiced amount estimate = $84,000 (before overage adjustments and any volume credits).

Operational notes on peaks:
- Our hosted burst routing will handle short 45 TPS bursts. For sustained >45 TPS for >10 mins we recommend a small reserved burst pool (we'll quantify GPU needs after a short load test).

Next steps:
1) Please confirm pilot acceptance of the $350 / 1M blended pilot rate and whether procurement wants a formal quote/DocuSign.
2) If accepted, I will send a formal quote and provisional timeline for a 2-week pilot toggle + optional load validation.

I copied procurement so they can advise on PO and vendor setup. Happy to hop on a 20-min call to walk through the numbers.

Best — Ben

Attachments: Redwood_pricing_v2.pdf
